assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
A 48-hour Holter monitor (CPT 93226) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management.
The service is medically necessary given the documented recurrent syncope and near-syncope.
The claim for CPT code 93226 has been denied.
The denial is based on reason code PR-204.
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within ninety days of this notice.
